gloss: Keep at least one item beyond the immediate horizon in every planning cycle
mechanism: Each planning cycle reviews at least one item on the {{roadmap}} beyond the current horizon. If a plan has held only near-horizon items for a stated number of cycles, the contraction is recorded and the horizon is reconsidered.
invariants: Each planning cycle reviews at least one item beyond the current horizon.
A plan that has held only near-horizon items for the stated number of cycles is flagged.
failure_modes: Horizon collapse: urgent work crowds out everything distant.
Distant theatre: long-range items are reviewed in name and never acted on.
